requirements.text: The system shall allow a customer to review the cart before payment.
ac: Cart page lists item name, quantity, unit price and line total.
Customer can change quantity or remove an item.

requirements.text: The system shall calculate the order total including VAT at 14 percent.
ac: Total equals the sum of line totals plus 14% VAT, rounded to two decimals.

requirements.text: The system must reject a coupon code that has expired.
ac: An expired coupon shows the message 'Coupon expired' and the total is unchanged.

requirements.text: The system shall support guest checkout without creating an account.
ac: Guest checkout requires only email, phone and delivery address.

requirements.text: The system shall send an order confirmation email within 5 minutes of successful payment.
ac: Email contains order number, items and total.

requirements.text: The system must not allow an order with a quantity greater than 10 for a single item.
